controls_twelve.txt: shuffled-key control (b186). For each transcription and key, the spelled values (tier A or B, three letters or fewer) used in the text
are shuffled among their tokens 5,000 times per seed and scored by a French character 4-gram model (add-0.1; Project Gutenberg 4650, 13951, 17489, 5097,
header guard as b138). Code words, unknown tokens, tier C, A2, A3, A4 and G rows are breaks, never scored (the logic of scripts/shuffle_control.py).
Run with the contributor's decode_v2.py (b94, md5 873d9923), the decoder of record for these letters. pool12 = the twelve read one after another.
v3 = key.tsv; v5 = key_v5.tsv (v5 adds no spelled value that the control scores, so v3 and v5 runs score the same tokens unless a G/A4 row replaces an unknown).
